paragraphs: Mentioned in Midrash Mishlei, chapter 15, but Hyman says it should read R' Chiyya bar Ba; he cites Yalkut Mishlei 553 as giving R' Chiyya bar Abba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rava, Ba and Abba are the three patronymic forms attributed to the named source texts.

The whole Buber digital Midrash Mishlei 15:1 already reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, distinct from Hyman’s Rava and proposed Ba. All three paragraphs of the retrieved Yalkut Nach 553 concern other material, a bounded nonmatch that does not prove absence elsewhere or repair Hyman’s locator. Book search removed the filter and gives no proof. The heading and proposed abbreviations remain R'; the inherited note is verbatim and Hyman’s “should read” retains its force.
